correctness.rationale: Four mixed-sign patterns with one minority sign yield eight triangles, one on each side of every arrangement edge. Their total geodesic perimeter is 8π, so the minimum is ≤π. Equality forces all four normal-triple spherical areas π, equivalent by the atan2 solid-angle formula to four linear Gram equations. They imply the unique orthogonal disphenoid parameterization. Polar rectangle integration gives the exact three quadrilateral perimeters and necessary and sufficient product inequalities; no finite sampling substitutes for these steps. The actual standalone checker passed 900 complete arrangement reconstructions.

originality.rationale: The sharp upper bound uses the established 8-triangle/6-quadrilateral incidence structure, but the complete non-rigid equality locus requires a separate four-triple solid-angle inversion, Gram-matrix classification and three independent rectangular solid-angle inequalities. The inspected 2026 area paper and 2022/24 inradius/circumradius paper do not state an equivalent sharp minimum-perimeter theorem or the exact two-dimensional optimizer region. Semantic searches and published mathematical-record summaries were compared; no mathematically dominating theorem was identified. This is a best-knowledge priority assessment, not a guarantee.
